fields.summary_ko.0: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) stock has appreciated 85.5% from November 20, 2025 to November 20, 2026, while the S&P 500 rose 6.9% over the same period.
fields.summary_ko.1: Fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $3.4 billion grew 39.2%, though reported operating margin declined from 12.5% to 2.8%, while adjusted operating margin improved slightly to 30.7%.
